papers.title_en: Velox: Learning Representations of 4D Geometry and Appearance
papers.authors: Anagh Malik, Dorian Chan, Xiaoming Zhao, David B. Lindell, Oncel Tuzel, Jen-Hao Rick Chang
papers.evidence: 学习4D几何与外观的表示
papers.tldr: Velox是一个学习4D物体几何与外观潜在表示的框架。它通过编码器将非结构化动态彩色点云压缩为动态形状标记，并利用4D表面解码器和高斯解码器分别捕捉几何演变和外观特征。该表示具有描述性强、压缩率高且易于获取的特点，在视频转4D生成、3D跟踪和布料模拟等下游任务中表现出色，为高效处理动态3D内容提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a framework for learning latent representations of 4D objects which are descriptive, faithfully capturing object geometry and appearance; compressive, aiding in downstream efficiency; and accessible, requiring minimal input, i.e., an unstructured dynamic point cloud, to construct. Specifically, Velox trains an encoder to compress spatiotemporal color point clouds into a set of dynamic shape tokens. These tokens are supervised using two complementary decoders: a 4D surface decoder, which models the time-varying surface distribution capturing the geometry; and a Gaussian decoder, which maps the tokens to 3D Gaussians, helping learn appearance. To demonstrate the utility of our representation, we evaluate it across three downstream tasks -- video-to-4D generation, 3D tracking, and cloth simulation via image-to-4D generation -- and observe strong performances in all settings.
